# Expected checksum mismatches (the checksum ratchet, see test_expected_checksum_mismatches).
#
# Each "<rom> | <label> | expected <stored> calculated <computed>" line is a
# checksum the resolver currently reports as a mismatch. The test fails if the
# set of reported mismatches differs from this list, so a NEW mismatch (a real
# regression - wrong offset/range/encoding, or a corrupt fixture) is caught, and
# a fixed one must be removed from the list deliberately.
#
# The remaining entries are either genuinely uninitialised/unset regions (a
# value and its checksum are both blank because that setting was never written,
# e.g. WPC Volume never set -> byte 0xff with checksum 0xffff), or records the
# upstream map marks with a _notes field as failing for that ROM revision
# (cv_20h and ww_lh5/ww_lh6 Credits, only valid for the "c" variants).
#
# Dump naming: <rom>.nv has at least one game played, <rom>-factoryreset.nv was
# booted to attract mode without playing (coin door closed, balls in the
# trough, post-reset alert acknowledged with a coin door button),
# <rom>-factoryreset-volumeup.nv additionally had the volume raised one step
# with the coin door open, <rom>-uninitialized.nv was quit during the boot
# sequence.
#
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.

bop_l8-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
cv_20h | Credits | expected 0xffff calculated 0xf807
f14_p5-uninitialized | Credits | expected 0x0 calculated 0xff
f14_p5-factoryreset | Credits | expected 0x0 calculated 0xff
mb_106-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
t2_p2f-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
taf_h4-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
taf_l4-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
taf_l5-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
tom_14h-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
wcs_p3-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
wcs_p6-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
wd_03r-uninitialized | The Roof Champion | expected 0x0 calculated 0xffff
wd_03r-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
wd_11-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
wd_12g-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
ww_p9-uninitialized | Volume | expected 0xffff calculated 0xff00
ww_lh6 | Credits | expected 0xffff calculated 0xf906
ww_lh6-default | Credits | expected 0xffff calculated 0xf906
